Subject: Re: MAP kickoff - deployment & region questions

Oliver — appreciated the call. I sketched an actionable MAP and attached a short slide with the timeline and decision points. High level recommendation:

- Short POC (3 weeks) on Hosted (us-west) to validate integration and baseline latency. Owner: Nexis engineering + Ben
- Parallel compliance run for EU production (2 weeks) to confirm Private deployment feasibility (on-prem or VPC) with KMS placement. Owner: Karthik + Nexis security
- Dedicated reserved capacity in eu-west for GA if Private adds >6 weeks; otherwise Dedicated for EU prod to meet SLA. Owner: Marissa

Key tradeoffs (summary):
- Hosted: fastest to start, lowest friction for POC, Redwood-managed keys by default (can be customer-managed with Private).
- Dedicated: predictable throughput, easier SLA for high-volume runs, still needs data residency plan.
- Private: best for strict residency/control but longer lead time (networking + HSM/KMS setup).

I added owners and provisional dates in the attached Nexis-MAP-v3.pdf. Can we lock calendar for the POC start on Mon 2026-11-30? That gives procurement a week to review the MAP.

Marissa Cole
Principal Sales, Redwood Inference

Adding technical and ops context — I reviewed their latency SLA request and the EU residency notes. Numbers and constraints: 

- Nexis target 99th pct latency < 300ms for inferencing with 2k qps bursts. Dedicated (A100 pool) meets this with our standard config; Hosted can meet it but requires reserved burst seats.
- For EU data residency: Private deployment (VPC with customer KMS) is the only option that fully satisfies their legal team. Dedicated + customer-managed KMS can be acceptable if logs/audit retention are routed to the EU.

Operational ramp proposal:
1) POC (11/30 -> 12/18) Hosted in us-west for integration + billing/metrics validation. (owner: Ben)
2) Compliance & residency pilot (12/6 -> 12/20) Private network feasibility in eu-west — validate KMS and audit log flow (owner: Karthik + Nexis security)
3) If pilot green, cutover to Private EU prod (target 01/15). If pilot needs more time, deploy Dedicated eu-west for GA by 01/05.

I can provide a quick TCO delta sheet for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private by tomorrow; it will show infra+ops delta per 100k tokens/day.

-Karthik
Director of Solutions, Redwood Inference
